The '''Tromper Crags Geothermal Plant''' was a massive geothermal energy plant located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. Originally belonging to [[Ortolan/Legends|Ortolan]] colonists, the plant was overtaken by [[White Maw]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
